title: A Hijacker Screams At A Monster Nobody Else Can See . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Death Note episode 4, a bus hijacker stares at the back seat and screams at a monster nobody else can see. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #recap #animerewind

segments.say: A hijacker on a bus stares at the back seat and screams at a monster nobody else can *see*.
To see how it got here, go back to Jack, riding the bus with a *stalker* on his tail.
Jack needs that man's name, and a bus full of strangers is his *plan*.
At the next stop, a drug addict climbs *aboard*.
He walks up the aisle and pulls out a *gun*.

segments.text: Stay in your seats unless you want to die!

segments.say: He wants all of yesterday's cash from the park, or every passenger *dies*.
Jack slips the girl a *note* with his plan.
But the stalker leans in. Too risky, he whispers. He will handle it *himself*.
So Jack turns on him. How does he know this man isn't the gunman's *partner*?
The stalker flashes his FBI *badge* to prove it. That was his first mistake.
Then the gunman storms to the back, and Jack lets the note *drop*.
The gunman grabs it, reads the plan, and *laughs*.
Then he looks up, and he *freezes*. Something sits in the back.
